Hi all — uploading the SKU map and a quick note on entitlements. See attached CSV (sku_mapping_v2.csv). Key clarifications:

- We create per-SKU lines for: token-gen (on-demand per-1k tokens), session-seat (for long-running agent seats), and private-offer-flat (monthly reserved).
- AMI visibility: marketplace requires the AMI to be linked with the Seller ID in the listing metadata. If AtlasOps wants to see runtime entitlement checks, we can add optional entitlement headers (X-RW-Account-ID) for validation.
- Regional SKUs: we recommend separate SKUs for us-east-1 and eu-west-1 if you plan to regionalize billing visibility — keeps usage attribution clear.

Notes for procurement: there are footnotes for trial credits and free-tier usage — those will appear as SKU footnotes in the listing.

Let me know if you want the CSV exported with or without pricing columns (I left pricing blank pending final numbers).

Kimberly Park
Marketplace Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
